title: Expense allocations + contract queries (scratchpad)
body:
Quick morning scratchpad for expense allocation tasks + a couple contract redline questions. Rough, will pare down for weekly sync.

Context / where I am: we closed a handful of vendor invoices last week that hit the wrong GL; need to re-allocate to product R&D vs. GTM. Also have a contract amendment from Vendor X with a weird indemnity clause change — want to capture my redlines before pinging Legal.

Top priorities (by EOD):
- Re-allocate INV-2025-119, INV-2026-003, INV-2026-011 to R&D 4301 per Q4 project mapping. (check with receipts folder first)
- Draft short note to vendor to confirm billing period change (they back-billed Sept).
- Capture contract redline bullets for Vendor X (see below) & attach to CON-4583.

Invoice checklist (quick):
- INV-2025-119 (BrightScale)
  - Amount: $12,480; originally coded to 5200 (GTM). Should be 4301 (R&D) because engineering service for feature A.
  - Evidence: invoice pdf in Drive => /shared_drives/company/misc/vendor-invoices/BrightScale-INV-2025-119.pdf (confirm date & PO)
  - Action: Submit journal entry request -> Finance Ops (Noah) by 3/6.

- INV-2026-003 (CloudOps partner)
  - Amount: $4,200; partial credit pending (credit mem 3/1). Wait to allocate until credit applied? Flagged in JIRA-3421.

- INV-2026-011 (Conference sponsorship)
  - Should remain GTM (5200) but split 60/40 because part of sponsorship funded product demo booth (split code 5200/4301). Need approval from Kate (marketing).

Questions to resolve (short):
- Do we do journal entries retroactively for charges older than 90 days? I remember a policy note but can't find it. (tagged policy-search in Slack)
- For cross-chargebacks to product teams, do we include internal VAT reclaim steps? (ask Sofia)

Contract redlines: Vendor X amendment (rough bullets)
- Clause 4.2 (Indemnity): vendor added broad carveouts for third-party claims; propose limiting indemnity to vendor negligence and IP infringement only. Draft suggested language: "Vendor indemnifies Redwood only for claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence or willful misconduct and for third-party claims of IP infringement directly attributable to Vendor-delivered deliverables."
- Clause 7 (Data handling): add requirement for notification within 48 hours of any suspected breach (they requested 7 days). Legal usually pushes 72 hours — propose 48/72 as negotiation point.
- Termination for convenience: ask for 60 days instead of 30 given integration work. Note: Sales might push back.

Email draft to legal (first pass):
Subject: Vendor X amendment — redline points for CON-4583
Hi Legal team (cc: Noah),
I'm attaching Vendor X's proposed amendment and my initial redline notes. High-level ask: tighten indemnity, shorten breach notice window, and extend termination window to 60 days. Also double-check whether the amendment creates any new data-subprocessing exposure.
I can sync for 20 min today after 2pm if useful.
Thanks,
Ella

Action items (short list):
- [ ] Upload journal entry request form for INV-2025-119 (Noah)
- [ ] Confirm credit mem application for INV-2026-003 before reallocation
- [ ] Ask Kate for 60/40 approval on INV-2026-011 allocation
- [ ] Finalize redline doc and attach to CON-4583; ping Legal (Sofia to review)
- [ ] Slack thread: #finance-billing -> policy around 90-day re-allocations (tag: @finance-ops)

Notes to self:
- If Legal pushes back on Vendor indemnity language, escalate to AM (Liam) — this vendor is strategic and we want a middle ground.
- Keep a record of all journal entries in the "chargebacks-2026" sheet (link to PR incoming).

Random reminders:
- Renewal watch: Contract with AnalyticsCo up in 45 days. They auto-renew unless we send notice; add to calendar and start redline if necessary.
- Tax: export Q4 contractor spend for 1099 prep (put in inbox for tax team).

Scratchpad timestamp: 2026-03-05 08:42 PT

End of quick dump. Will tidy into a proper checklist for weekly sync with Finance Ops and Legal.
